All six present and correct: the dotted double-helix mark, the 'Skingenetix' wordmark, 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR', 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' in pink, 'PREMIUM FORMULA', and 'PDRN | COLLAGEN | COPPER PEPTIDE | 50ML'. RESOLUTION IS AN UPGRADE. The file it replaces is 1024x1024, which caps the theme's generated srcset at 1000w and serves an upscale to a 2x screen. At 2048 the srcset reaches 2000w.

WHAT IT REPLACES. skingenetix-pdrn-collagen-repair-cream-bottle.jpg, 1024x1024. It stays in Files and simply stops being referenced — nothing is renamed or overwritten, because Langify keys translations off the URL.

MASTER IS SQUARE, which media-with-text requires: the row height is max(text column, image natural height) and .media-with-text__media carries no aspect-ratio of its own, so a non-square master stretches its row and the block stops matching its five siblings. This block measured 0.906 at 1440 before the swap, tied with the pdrn_serum block directly above it, inside a sibling range of 0.906-1.000. A square master leaves that geometry untouched.

FILENAME AUDITED FOR PREFIXES, NOT JUST EXACT COLLISION. Nineteen files already share a skingenetix-pdrn-collagen- stem, and one of them being a strict prefix of a new name is the shape that once bound two slots to the same uploaded file while polling. Checked every one: none is a prefix of skingenetix-pdrn-collagen-overnight-repair-cream-open-jar-lid, and there is no exact match. Verified after upload that the resolved handle carries no suffix.

WEB LOADING. Converted from the 1784K PNG to JPEG q95 4:4:4 progressive with metadata dropped, 757K — the documented policy in .claude/rules/website-imagery.md rule 5: quality 95 and 4:4:4 so the CDN's WebP pass encodes from a clean picture rather than one already full of JPEG artefacts. Not re-encoded below that; compressing the source was measured on 2026-08-24 and made the site marginally slower. Long edge 2048, inside the 3000px cap and above the 2000w top of this block's srcset. Delivered bytes verified off the CDN after upload, because the CDN is what a visitor downloads.

SEO FILENAME built from the page and the block: brand, 'pdrn' and 'collagen' and 'overnight repair' and 'cream' from the block title 'PDRN + Collagen Overnight Repair Cream', and 'open jar lid' for what is in frame. 65 characters.
